wp.description: Primary WordPress agent. Owns the agentic loop and delegates to pipeline and domain sub-agents. Pipeline: requirement-asker → wp-lingo-translator → requirement-asker → requirement-generator → task-generator → tracer-bullet → issue-creator → implementor → qc → code-reviewer.

requirement-asker.description: Interviews the user via the question tool to cover all needed details before a spec is written.

requirement-generator.description: Turns interview notes into a macro-requirements spec document.

wp-lingo-translator.description: Converts layman requirements into WordPress terms and delegates back to the requirement-asker for storage/implementation decisions.

task-generator.description: Turns a spec into a phased plan with TDD steps, checkpoints, and commit SHAs. Has edit:allow so it can write docs/plans/; it must NOT edit source code.

tracer-bullet.description: Builds a vertical slice / tracer bullet to validate an approach before full implementation.

issue-creator.description: Opens a GitHub issue from a spec or plan using gh.

implementor.description: Implements an approved plan task by task, running checks after each task.

qc.description: Local review agent. Runs the built-in /review on the working tree before a PR is opened.

code-reviewer.description: Reviews a diff in a fresh context before a PR. Reports findings, does not edit.

adr-agent.description: Builds ADRs and other engineering and architectural design documents.

research-agent.description: Explores codebases and writes learnings back to memory/skills so the loop self-evolves.

interactivity-api.description: Domain expert in the WordPress Interactivity API (data-wp directives, script modules, client-side navigation).

html-api.description: Domain expert in the WordPress HTML API (WP_HTML_Tag_Processor, WP_HTML_Processor).

block-markup-designer.description: Domain expert in block markup, block.json, and block registration.

security-agent.description: Domain expert in WordPress security: escaping, nonces, sanitization, capability checks.

rest-api.description: Domain expert in the WordPress REST API: register_rest_route, WP_REST_Controller, schema/validation, permission_callback/auth, response shaping, register_rest_field/register_meta.

block-themes.description: Domain expert in WordPress block themes: theme.json (settings/styles), templates and template parts, patterns, style variations, Site Editor troubleshooting.

plugin-development.description: Domain expert in WordPress plugin development: architecture and hooks, activation/deactivation/uninstall, Settings API, data storage, cron, security, release packaging.

performance.description: Domain expert in WordPress performance: profiling (WP-CLI profile/doctor, Server-Timing), database/query optimization, autoloaded options, object caching, cron, HTTP API.

phpstan.description: Domain expert in PHPStan static analysis for WordPress: phpstan.neon setup, baselines, WordPress-specific typing, third-party plugin classes.

wpcli-ops.description: Domain expert in WP-CLI operations: safe search-replace, db export/import, plugin/theme/user/content management, cron, cache flushing, multisite, wp-cli.yml automation.

playground.description: Domain expert in WordPress Playground: routing, local CLI runs, browser previews, snapshots, mounts, version switching, and Blueprint JSON authoring.

project-triage.description: Deterministically inspects a WordPress repository (plugin/theme/block theme/core/Gutenberg) and reports tooling, tests, and version hints to guide workflows.

abilities-api.description: Domain expert in the WordPress Abilities API: wp_register_ability, categories, REST exposure, and permission checks for clients.

query.description: Domain expert in WP_Query and the query classes: class-wp-query, class-wp-meta-query, class-wp-date-query, class-wp-tax-query. Covers query args, pagination, and performance.

taxonomy.description: Domain expert in WordPress taxonomies and terms: taxonomy.php, class-wp-taxonomy, term queries, and term meta.

media.description: Domain expert in WordPress media: media.php, attachments, image editing (class-wp-image-editor), and the media library.

cron.description: Domain expert in WordPress cron: cron.php, wp_schedule_event, scheduled events, and wp-cron behavior.

multisite.description: Domain expert in WordPress multisite: ms-*.php, network, sites, blogs, and site queries.

rewrite.description: Domain expert in WordPress rewrite rules and permalinks: class-wp-rewrite, add_rewrite_rule, and flush_rewrite_rules.

http.description: Domain expert in the WordPress HTTP API: class-wp-http, wp_remote_get/post, and HTTP request handling.

option.description: Domain expert in WordPress options: option.php, get_option/update_option, autoload, and transients.

formatting.description: Domain expert in WordPress formatting and sanitization functions: formatting.php, esc_* helpers, and wp_kses.

customize.description: Domain expert in the WordPress Customizer: class-wp-customize-manager, settings, panels, sections, and controls.

widgets.description: Domain expert in WordPress widgets: the widgets directory, WP_Widget, and widget registration.

feed.description: Domain expert in WordPress feeds: feed.php, RSS/Atom output, and feed templates.

shortcode.description: Domain expert in WordPress shortcodes: shortcodes.php, add_shortcode, and shortcode attributes.

nav-menu.description: Domain expert in WordPress navigation menus: nav-menu.php, wp_nav_menu, and menu locations.

locale.description: Domain expert in WordPress localization: class-wp-locale, i18n, translations, and locale switching.

sitemaps.description: Domain expert in WordPress sitemaps: the sitemaps directory, class-wp-sitemaps, and sitemap providers.

block-bindings.description: Domain expert in WordPress block bindings: block-bindings.php, the block-bindings registry, and binding sources.

ai-client.description: Domain expert in the WordPress AI client: the ai-client directory, adapters, and AI client APIs.

start-loop.description: Start the agentic loop. If a spec path is given, produce a plan and stop for approval. If no spec is given, run the requirement-asker first.
start-loop.template: If $1 is provided, read the spec at $1, produce a plan, and stop for approval. If $1 is empty, trigger the requirement-asker to interview the user and generate the spec first. Do not edit code until the plan is approved.

address-review.description: Address GitHub review comments on the current PR.
address-review.template: Address the following review comments on the current PR: $ARGUMENTS. Re-run checks and update the PR.
